evidence.quote: If you have a school leaving certificate from Morocco, you will need to submit the following documents: overview of your subjects and grades ("Relevé de Notes") of the Baccalauréat
If you hold a degree from a Moroccan university, you will need to submit the following documents: Degree certificate Complete transcript of records, including all courses and results
If you took the "classes préparatoires" you will need to submit your transcript of records of these classes.
A Baccalauréat alone does not allow you to study directly in Germany. It qualifies you for the Studienkolleg (preparatory course) and the "Feststellungsprüfung" (university qualification exam).
Your certificates must be official: official certificates are those bearing a signature and stamp from the issuing institution, a reference to their automatic issuance or a verification code.
Upload your education certificates in their original language, accompanied by a translation into German or English.

We accept translations of certificates from the following sources: persons or institutions authorised to make translations under oath or admissible in court, a department of the issuing school or university authorised to issue such translations.

name.fr: Relevé de notes du Baccalauréat (« Relevé de Notes » : aperçu des matières et des notes)
name.en: Baccalauréat grade transcript ("Relevé de Notes": overview of subjects and grades)

name.fr: Diplôme universitaire (seulement si vous avez un diplôme d’une université marocaine)
name.en: Degree certificate (only if you hold a degree from a Moroccan university)

name.fr: Relevé de notes universitaire complet, avec tous les cours et résultats (seulement si vous avez un diplôme d’une université marocaine)
name.en: Complete university transcript of records, including all courses and results (only if you hold a degree from a Moroccan university)

name.fr: Relevé de notes des classes préparatoires (seulement si vous avez suivi des classes préparatoires)
name.en: Transcript of records of the classes préparatoires (only if you took classes préparatoires)

items.quotedAs: transcript of records of these classes

entries.notes: General uni-assist guidance for applicants with a Moroccan certificate, not a requirement of each university: the university may ask for more, and documents are checked per university. Only the Baccalauréat grade transcript applies to a school leaver; the degree certificate, the university transcript and the classes préparatoires transcript apply only to applicants who have studied at a Moroccan university or in a prépa. The Morocco page says a Baccalauréat alone does not allow studying directly in Germany: it qualifies for the Studienkolleg (preparatory course) and the Feststellungsprüfung (university qualification exam). General uni-assist rules (educational-certificates and translations pages), not tied to one document by a quote, so no item carries a translation flag: certificates must be official, that is bearing a signature and stamp from the issuing institution, a reference to their automatic issuance or a verification code; upload them in the original language with a translation into German or English (not needed if the country also issues the certificate in German or English; exceptions are listed per country, and the Morocco page lists none); translations are accepted from persons or institutions authorised to make translations under oath or admissible in court, or from a department of the issuing school or university authorised to issue such translations, not from standard translation agencies. Attaches to programmes whose application channel is uni-assist or uni-assist VPD, so run it again after the German channel batch (national-de-channel) is promoted.
